evidence_limits: These are completed native tests/test.sh produce runs and a native pair verifier, not Docker build/solve/selfcheck evidence.
Each nominal and variant output was independently compared to a reference calculated for that exact input.
Algorithm/reference disagreement, nominal-versus-variant input response and same-build repeat variation are distinct quantities.
Three identical-input samples on four earlier solver-only probes showed zero observed repeat variation; no alternate-build floor was measured.
Thresholds are provisional and remain subject to user confirmation after container calibration.
Timing totals exclude no work unless labeled: run_excluding_build includes process startup, first-use JIT, oracle evaluation and output I/O.
No full state, reference Hamiltonian, reference output array or private absolute path is included in this report.

native_environment.concurrency_note: The nominal and variant produce suites partially overlapped, each suite running one check at a time.
